resolution_notes: Both verifiers agree free-tier limits and rate limits are published. Verifying free plan quotas and API rate-limit docs against Resend's current official pages.
free_tier_limits: Free plan: 3,000 emails/month and 100 emails/day; 1 custom domain (confirm against current pricing).
rate_limits: Default ~2 requests/second for most endpoints; higher on paid plans; separate daily/monthly send quotas (confirm against current rate-limit docs).
